A flat 4 lap 5 mile course was made for Stuart who ran his best race to date finishing in 50th place in this world class field, beating in the process 2 of the England team and 3 of the Scottish team. A measure of his great run was that English Star Jon Richards could only manage 8th in 23.11 while Stuart ran 24.36.
